A scrollable message log that sticks to the bottom as new content streams in, unless the user has scrolled up — in which case a jump-to-bottom button appears.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/Conversation.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Conversation } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
